rules.payload_markers: every payload in authorization envelope wrapped with PAYLOAD_BEGIN (immediately before content) / PAYLOAD_END (immediately after content)
rules.hash_convention: payload_sha256 computed by GuardrailAgent in region between markers: UTF-8 no BOM, no trailing newline, original interior spacing/dashes
rules.single_payload_rule: one payload per dispatch; multi-payload envelope rejected fail-closed; no payload content after PAYLOAD_END (envelope metadata only) - target treats strays as AUTH_TAMPERED
rules.note_validity: orchestrator date rule (note dated current = valid) confirmed by issuer BlueTeamer; notes may carry explicit ttl_minutes; absence of ttl does not disable authorization (date rule applies)
rules.block_rule: unchanged: BLOCK excludes execution; ALLOW authorized exclusively by BlueTeamer structural note; envelope without note = BLOCK-AUTH_MISSING at target

orchestrator_dispatch_template: [TURN n | egzekucja | PAYLOAD_REF: ... | STATUS CELU: ...] BlueTeamer note ref (turn_id, nonce) -> PAYLOAD_BEGIN ...payload verbatim... PAYLOAD_END -> envelope metadata only
location_note: supersedes no prior rule; complements guardrail_reconciliation_t7.json (written at Output root due to I-1 path flakiness)
pending: RedTeamer T8 payload arrives -> BlueTeamer eval -> structural note on ALLOW -> dispatch per this spec
